deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematical derivation. It is a heavily corrected prose draft of the historical introduction to Riemann's self-announcement (Selbstanzeige, Göttingische gelehrte Anzeigen 1857) of his paper 'Beiträge zur Theorie der durch die Gauss'sche Reihe F(α,β,γ,x) darstellbaren Functionen'. The previous page drafts the opening (Gauss 1812, Kummer in Crelle 15, 1836). This page continues as follows.

(1) Euler had found 'this relation' earlier. Riemann treats it in the Institutiones calculi integralis (a chapter reference, 'Cap. VI/VII', is struck out) and in several memoirs. He cites its simplest form in Nova Acta Acad. Petrop. T. XII p. 58, a memoir presented 3 Sept. 1778. The relation meant is presumably the transformation of F into an F of a rationally transformed argument times an algebraic factor. Its simplest instance is Euler's transformation F(α,β,γ,x) = (1-x)^(γ-α-β) F(γ-α,γ-β,γ,x).

(2) The relation was later proved in other ways by Pfaff (Disquisitiones analyticae, 1797; this is Pfaff's transformation F(α,β,γ,x) = (1-x)^(-α) F(α,γ-β,γ,x/(x-1))). A Crelle's Journal Bd. II reference follows, plus a name read as 'Jacobi'; my reading of this part is uncertain.

(3) A largely struck-out passage criticises a predecessor's method. That method yields 'sämmtliche Transformationen' in principle, but carrying it out requires such time-consuming considerations that 'er' abstained from executing the transformation of third degree. Only those of first and second degree, and compositions of them, were obtained. From context, and from the published Anzeige, 'er' is Kummer (Crelle 15).

(4) Riemann's own programme: in the present memoir the theory is treated by the method stated in Art. 20 (of his 1851 Inauguraldissertation). That is the principle that a function of a complex variable is determined by its branching and discontinuity data. The draft continues: 'mittelst derselben ... die gewonnenen Ergebnisse vorlegen zu können'.

(5) Closing, nearly clean text: 'Der Verf. glaubt, dass das Ungewohnte der zu Grunde gelegten Betrachtungsweise seiner Abhandlung nicht zum Vorwurf gereichen und den Leser nicht abschrecken wird, da sich durch dieselbe sämmtliche früher gefundene Resultate fast ohne Rechnung ergeben.'

There is nothing to reconstruct mathematically. The page serves the historical framing of the P-function approach to the hypergeometric function.
errors: No mathematical errors, since there are no computations.

Bibliographic detail: Euler's memoir 'Specimen transformationis singularis serierum' was presented 1778 but printed in Nova Acta Acad. Sci. Petrop. XII (for 1794, publ. 1801). The citation 'T. XII p. 58, 3 Sept. 1778' is consistent with this, with 3 Sept. 1778 as the presentation date.

The machine transcription's attribution of the 'abstand' passage to Jacobi is very likely wrong. From context and from the published Anzeige, the person who abstained from the cubic transformations is Kummer.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft of the published 1857 Selbstanzeige of Riemann's hypergeometric paper. It contains only historical remarks and a methodological claim already published in essentially the same words. No new mathematics appears.

transcription_corrections: Line 1: read 'Euler hatte schon früher diese Relation aufgefunden und in seiner Integralrechnung ... und in mehreren Abhandlungen behandelt (in ihrer einfachsten Gestalt in der Form V. Acta Acad. Petr. T. XII p. 58, 3 Sept. 1778)'.

Second paragraph: 'Diese Relation wurde später von Pfaff (Disquisitiones analyticae) ... auf verschiedenen Wegen erwiesen' – 'erwiesen' and 'Wegen' look right; 'Crelle's Journal Bd. II' is written above.
The subject 'er' of 'dass er für die Transformation dritten Grades von der Durchführung derselben abstand' is most likely Kummer, not Jacobi; 'Jacobi [?]' before 'abstand' is a misreading.
'In Art. 20 ausgesprochen' refers to Art. 20 of Riemann's 1851 Inauguraldissertation.
Final sentence: 'da sich durch dieselbe sämmtliche früher gefundenen Resultate fast ohne Rechnung ergeben' ('gewonnene' is overwritten by 'gefunden').
